I replied to Tobias in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket. I also passed on the caveat from that message: the file labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, so this had to be fixed before anyone reimported, or duplicates would be created.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, and ticket numbers are operational facts, so it was fine to share in #central-random. I found it in GBrain and had already seen the same message in #central-team. Nothing there showed a later ticket update or whether the door labels were fixed.
